# v1 golden fixture

These two short English texts are project-authored test material released under
CC0-1.0. They are not learner writing, are not generated by an external API,
and contain no personal data. Their sole purpose is to exercise the frozen v1
analysis and export contracts with redistributable runtime resources.

`expected-single.json` is the first document payload from the canonical batch.
`expected-batch.json` covers the multi-document payload and diagnostics. The
two `expected-*-workbook.json` files store sheet order, dimensions, and every
cell value after reading the generated XLSX. `manifest.json` pins all input and
expected-output hashes, application/output-schema identities, production wheel
lock, and Python base-image identity. The XLSX binary hashes remain provisional until the
release container image digest is frozen; semantic workbook snapshots are the
cross-platform normative contract.

Regeneration is deliberately explicit and requires the audited clean runtime:

```bash
python scripts/build_v1_golden_fixtures.py --write
python scripts/build_v1_golden_fixtures.py --check
```

Never update expected files merely to make a test pass. Review the numerical,
schema, resource, privacy, and SemVer reason for every delta first. An application
or output-schema version change that is visible in an export necessarily changes
the canonical fixture and must be reviewed as version metadata, even when no
metric value changes.
